keys_my_keys_heading.description: Keys tab: heading above the user's own key list.

keys_empty.message: No keys yet. Generate or import a key to get started.
keys_empty.description: Keys tab: shown when the user has no keys of their own.

keys_generate_button.description: Keys tab: button opening the key generation page. Short, shares a row with Import Key.

keys_import_button.description: Keys tab: button opening the key import page. Short, shares a row with Generate Key.

keys_unknown_name.description: Fallback display name for a key or contact with no user ID at all.

keys_exported_one.description: Toast after a bulk export. $count$ is the number of keys exported.

keys_exported_other.description: Toast after a bulk export. $count$ is the number of keys exported.

keys_exported_unsafe_one.description: Toast after a bulk export where private keys were written without a passphrase. $count$ is the number of keys. Keep the warning emphatic (uppercase).

keys_exported_unsafe_other.description: Toast after a bulk export where private keys were written without a passphrase. $count$ is the number of keys. Keep the warning emphatic (uppercase).

keys_reselect.description: Toast action button after a bulk export: restores the previous selection. Very short.

keys_ssh_export_skipped_one.message: $count$ SSH key can't be exported - an imported SSH key never leaves this device.
keys_ssh_export_skipped_one.description: Toast when a bulk export selection included SSH keys, which are skipped. $count$ is how many were skipped.

keys_ssh_export_skipped_other.message: $count$ SSH keys can't be exported - an imported SSH key never leaves this device.
keys_ssh_export_skipped_other.description: Toast when a bulk export selection included SSH keys, which are skipped. $count$ is how many were skipped.

keys_rename_key_title.description: Title of the rename page for one of the user's own keys.

keys_rename_crx_title.description: Title of the rename page for a Chrome extension (CRX) signing key.

keys_rename_contact_title.description: Title of the rename page for a contact.

keys_rename_field_label.description: Rename page: label of the text field holding the local display name.

keys_rename_hint.message: Shown in place of $identity$. This is a local label only.
keys_rename_hint.description: Rename page: hint under the field. $identity$ is the key's real name (user ID, key comment or extension ID) that the alias will stand in for.

keys_rename_placeholder_key.description: Rename page placeholder for one of the user's own keys: an example alias.

keys_rename_placeholder_crx.description: Rename page placeholder for a CRX signing key: an example label.

keys_rename_placeholder_contact.description: Rename page placeholder for a contact: an example alias.

keys_revocation_unlock_first.message: Unlock this key first, then try again.
keys_revocation_unlock_first.description: Error shown when the user tries to create a revocation certificate while the key is locked.

keys_bulk_delete_title.description: Title of the confirmation page for deleting a bulk selection.

keys_bulk_delete_confirm_one.description: Confirm button of the bulk delete page. $count$ is the number of selected keys and contacts.

keys_bulk_delete_confirm_other.description: Confirm button of the bulk delete page. $count$ is the number of selected keys and contacts.

keys_bulk_delete_prompt_one.description: Bulk delete page: the exact phrase the user must type to confirm deleting private keys. $count$ is the number of selected items. Shown to the user and compared with what they type; keep it short and easy to type.

keys_bulk_delete_prompt_other.description: Bulk delete page: the exact phrase the user must type to confirm deleting private keys. $count$ is the number of selected items. Shown to the user and compared with what they type; keep it short and easy to type.

keys_contacts_removed_one.description: Toast after removing contacts (public keys). Singular form has no count.

keys_contacts_removed_other.description: Toast after removing contacts (public keys). $count$ is how many were removed.

keys_undo.description: Toast action button that re-adds just-removed contacts. Very short.

keys_confirm_remove_contact_title.description: Title of the confirmation page for removing a contact.

keys_confirm_delete_key_title.description: Title of the confirmation page for deleting one of the user's own keys.

keys_remove_contact.description: Remove a contact: confirm button on the removal page, contact card menu item, and details page action label.

keys_delete_key_permanently.description: Confirm button on the delete page for one of the user's own keys.

keys_count_private_keys_one.description: Bulk delete summary: part of a comma-separated list of what is selected. $count$ is a number.

keys_count_private_keys_other.description: Bulk delete summary: part of a comma-separated list of what is selected. $count$ is a number.

keys_count_signing_keys_one.description: Bulk delete summary: part of a comma-separated list of what is selected (CRX extension signing keys). $count$ is a number.

keys_count_signing_keys_other.description: Bulk delete summary: part of a comma-separated list of what is selected (CRX extension signing keys). $count$ is a number.

keys_count_contacts_one.description: Bulk delete summary: part of a comma-separated list of what is selected. $count$ is a number.

keys_count_contacts_other.description: Bulk delete summary: part of a comma-separated list of what is selected. $count$ is a number.

keys_bulk_delete_private_body.message: This permanently deletes the selected private keys from this device. Anything encrypted only to a deleted key becomes unrecoverable. Make sure you have a backup if you might ever need them.
keys_bulk_delete_private_body.description: Bulk delete page: warning body when the selection includes private keys.

keys_bulk_delete_contacts_body.message: You'll no longer be able to encrypt to these contacts or verify their signatures. You can re-import their public keys later.
keys_bulk_delete_contacts_body.description: Bulk delete page: body when only contacts are selected.

keys_delete_crx_body.message: You can no longer sign updates for this extension, and the key can't be recovered unless you have a backup.
keys_delete_crx_body.description: Delete page body for a CRX extension signing key.

keys_delete_key_body.message: This permanently deletes the private key from this device. Anything encrypted only to this key becomes unrecoverable. Make sure you have a backup if you might ever need it.
keys_delete_key_body.description: Delete page body for one of the user's own keys.

keys_remove_contact_body.message: You'll no longer be able to encrypt messages to this contact or verify their signatures. You can re-import their public key later.
keys_remove_contact_body.description: Remove page body for a contact.

keys_contacts_heading.description: Keys tab: heading above the contact list, when the list is empty.

keys_contacts_heading_encrypted.description: Keys tab: contacts heading while the vault is locked and contacts cannot be read.

keys_contacts_heading_count.description: Keys tab: contacts heading with the number of contacts. $count$ is a number.

keys_contacts_locked.message: Contacts are encrypted. Unlock PGP Tools to view and manage them.
keys_contacts_locked.description: Keys tab: notice shown in place of the contact list while the vault is locked. 'PGP Tools' is the product name; keep it.

keys_search_contacts_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the contact search field.

keys_no_contacts_match.description: Contact search: empty result. $query$ is what the user typed.

keys_wrong_password.description: Key card: error after a failed password unlock.

keys_passkey_failed.description: Key card: error after a failed passkey unlock.

keys_status_unlocked.description: Key card: tooltip on the lock icon when the key is unlocked for this session.

keys_status_locked.description: Key card: tooltip on the lock icon when the key is locked.

keys_status_sealed.description: Key card: tooltip on the lock icon for a key that has no session unlock (CRX signing key), meaning it stays encrypted until used.

keys_default_badge.description: Small pill after a key's name marking it as the default key. One word.

keys_default_title.message: Used by default for signing, decrypting, and encrypt-to-self

keys_key_options_aria.description: Accessible label of the three-dot menu button on a key card.

keys_rename.description: Menu item / action label: open the rename page.

keys_public_key_copied.description: Key card: inline feedback after copying the public key.

keys_copy_public_key.description: Menu item / action label: copy the public key to the clipboard.

keys_download_public_key.description: Menu item / action label: download the public key as a file.

keys_copy_private_key.description: Key card menu item: opens the private key export page. Destructive styling.

keys_select.description: Card menu item: enter bulk selection mode with this card selected.

keys_delete_key.description: Key card menu item and details page action: delete one of the user's own keys.

keys_protection_passkey.description: How a private key is protected at rest: a passkey. Shown on the key card and as a chip on the details page.

keys_protection_password.description: How a private key is protected at rest: a password. Shown on the key card and as a chip on the details page.

keys_weak_sha1.description: Small warning pill on a key or contact card whose certificate relies on SHA-1. Keep 'SHA-1'.

keys_enter_password_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the inline password field used to unlock a key on its card.

keys_key_details.description: Title of the key details page, and accessible label / tooltip of the buttons that open it.

keys_details_aria.description: Accessible label of the key details panel. $name$ is the key's display name.

keys_cap_sign.description: What a component key can do; part of a list separated by a middle dot.

keys_cap_encrypt.description: What a component key can do; part of a list separated by a middle dot.

keys_cap_auth.description: What a component key can do; part of a list separated by a middle dot.

keys_cap_certify.description: What a component key can do (certification); part of a list separated by a middle dot.

keys_banner_revoked_title.description: Key details: red status banner title for a revoked key.

keys_banner_no_reason.description: Key details: revoked banner line when the certificate carries no revocation reason.

keys_banner_revoked_own.message: Generate or import a replacement key.
keys_banner_revoked_own.description: Key details: revoked banner advice for one of the user's own keys.

keys_banner_revoked_contact.message: Do not encrypt to it or trust new signatures from it.
keys_banner_revoked_contact.description: Key details: revoked banner advice for a contact's key.

keys_banner_expired_title.description: Key details: red banner title for an expired key. $when$ is a relative time such as '2 months ago'.

keys_banner_expired_on.description: Key details: expired banner line. $date$ is a localised long date.

keys_banner_expired_own.message: Generate or import a newer key.
keys_banner_expired_own.description: Key details: expired banner advice for one of the user's own keys.

keys_banner_expired_contact.message: Ask the owner for an updated key.
keys_banner_expired_contact.description: Key details / import preview: expired banner advice for a contact's key.

keys_banner_unusable_title.description: Key details: red banner title when the key can neither encrypt nor sign.

keys_banner_unusable_body.message: It has no usable encryption or signing subkey.
keys_banner_unusable_body.description: Key details: unusable banner line when the engine gave no specific reason.

keys_banner_encrypt_only_own.message: You can receive encrypted messages, but this key can't sign.
keys_banner_encrypt_only_own.description: Key details: amber banner for one of the user's own keys that can only encrypt.

keys_banner_encrypt_only_contact.message: You can encrypt to it, but it can't sign.
keys_banner_encrypt_only_contact.description: Key details: amber banner for a contact's key that can only encrypt.

keys_banner_sign_only_own.message: You can sign messages, but this key can't receive encrypted ones.
keys_banner_sign_only_own.description: Key details: amber banner for one of the user's own keys that can only sign.

keys_banner_sign_only_contact.message: You can verify its signatures, but can't encrypt to it.
keys_banner_sign_only_contact.description: Key details: amber banner for a contact's key that can only sign.

keys_banner_expires_soon.description: Key details: amber banner title when the key expires within 30 days.

keys_subkey_label.description: Heading of one component-key row in a certificate breakdown.

keys_bits.description: Key size, e.g. '4096-bit'. $bits$ is a number.

keys_row_created.description: Subkey row: creation date clause, lowercase, in a middle-dot separated line. $date$ is a localised short date.

keys_row_expires.description: Subkey row: expiry clause for a still-valid subkey, lowercase. $date$ is a localised short date.

keys_row_expired.description: Subkey row: expiry clause for an expired subkey, lowercase. $date$ is a localised short date.

keys_row_never_expires.description: Subkey row: clause for a subkey with no expiry, lowercase.

keys_revoked_reason.description: Subkey row: revocation reason line. $reason$ is text from the certificate.

keys_also_known_as.description: Key details: small uppercase label above the key's other email addresses.

keys_loading.description: Key details: shown while the certificate is being parsed.

keys_copy_fingerprint_aria.description: Accessible label of the copy button next to the fingerprint.

keys_fact_fingerprint.description: Key facts card row label. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_fact_algorithm.description: Key facts card row label. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_fact_used_for.description: Key facts card row label: what the primary key can do. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_fact_created.description: Key facts card row label: creation date. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_fact_expires.description: Key facts card row label: expiry date. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_fact_added.description: Key facts card row label: when the key was added to this app. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_fact_last_used.description: Key facts card row label: when the key was last unlocked. Fits a narrow (5rem) column.

keys_never.description: Key facts card: expiry value for a key that never expires.

keys_expires_value.description: Key facts card: expiry value. $date$ is a localised long date, $when$ a relative time such as 'in 3 months'.

keys_subkeys_title.description: Heading of the certificate's subkey list (a count follows in parentheses).

keys_group_row_label.description: Heading of one row when a contact holds several separate SSH keys (peers, not subkeys).

keys_subkeys_truncated.message: This certificate has an unusually large number of subkeys; only the first $count$ are shown.
keys_subkeys_truncated.description: Warning above the subkey list when the parser capped it. $count$ is the number shown (always more than one).

keys_no_subkeys.message: This key has no subkeys; the primary key does everything itself.
keys_no_subkeys.description: Shown in the subkey section when the certificate has no subkeys.

keys_inactive_subkeys_expired_one.description: Toggle button revealing hidden inactive subkeys, all of which are expired. $count$ is a number.

keys_inactive_subkeys_expired_other.description: Toggle button revealing hidden inactive subkeys, all of which are expired. $count$ is a number.

keys_inactive_subkeys_revoked_one.description: Toggle button revealing hidden inactive subkeys, all of which are revoked. $count$ is a number.

keys_inactive_subkeys_revoked_other.description: Toggle button revealing hidden inactive subkeys, all of which are revoked. $count$ is a number.

keys_inactive_subkeys_unusable_one.description: Toggle button revealing hidden inactive subkeys of mixed or invalid status. $count$ is a number.

keys_inactive_subkeys_unusable_other.description: Toggle button revealing hidden inactive subkeys of mixed or invalid status. $count$ is a number.

keys_revocation_certificate.description: Key details: section heading, and the clipboard label when the certificate is copied.

keys_revocation_created.description: Toast after a revocation certificate was generated.

keys_revocation_create_failed.message: Could not create a revocation certificate.
keys_revocation_create_failed.description: Error when generating a revocation certificate fails for an unknown reason.

keys_revocation_have_body.message: If this key is ever lost or compromised, publishing this certificate tells your contacts to stop using the key. Back it up somewhere safe - anyone who holds it can revoke your key.
keys_revocation_have_body.description: Key details: explanation shown when the key has a stored revocation certificate.

keys_revocation_missing_body.message: This key was imported without a revocation certificate. Create one now and back it up, so you can revoke the key later even if you lose access to it.
keys_revocation_missing_body.description: Key details: explanation shown when an imported key has no revocation certificate yet.

keys_revocation_creating.description: Button label while a revocation certificate is being generated.

keys_revocation_create.description: Button that generates a revocation certificate for an imported key.

keys_chip_your_key.description: Small chip on the details page of one of the user's own keys. Short.

keys_chip_contact.description: Small chip on the details page of a contact's key. Short.

keys_ssh_chip_title.message: An SSH key, used with age. It can't be combined with PGP recipients in one message.
keys_ssh_chip_title.description: Tooltip on the SSH badge of a key or contact. 'age' is the name of the encryption tool; keep it lowercase.

keys_chip_protection_title.message: How the private key is protected at rest
keys_chip_protection_title.description: Tooltip on the Passkey / Password chip on the details page.

keys_parse_failed.description: Key details: error when the stored certificate cannot be parsed.

keys_save_failed.description: Toast when toggling one of a contact's keys on or off could not be persisted.

keys_recipient_off_title.message: Messages to this contact are not encrypted to this key.
keys_recipient_off_title.description: Tooltip on the 'Not used' pill of a contact's key that the user turned off.

keys_recipient_not_used.description: Small amber pill on a contact's key row that the user turned off. Short.

keys_recipient_last_active_title.message: This is the only key left in use. Turning it off too would encrypt messages to nobody.
keys_recipient_last_active_title.description: Tooltip on the disabled 'Don't use' button when it is the contact's last enabled key.

keys_recipient_enable_title.description: Tooltip on the 'Use' button of a turned-off key.

keys_recipient_disable_title.message: Stop encrypting to this key. It stays listed here.
keys_recipient_disable_title.description: Tooltip on the 'Don't use' button of an enabled key.

keys_recipient_use.description: Tiny button on a contact's key row: turn this key back on. Very short.

keys_recipient_dont_use.description: Tiny button on a contact's key row: stop encrypting to this key. Very short.

keys_encrypt_to.description: Action on a contact: open the workspace with this contact preselected as recipient.

keys_remove_default.description: Details page action label: clear this key as the default key.

keys_set_default.description: Details page action label: make this key the default key.

keys_default_removed.description: Toast after clearing the default key.

keys_default_set.description: Toast after setting the default key.

keys_contact_keys_partial_title.message: Messages are encrypted to $active$ of this contact's $total$ keys; the rest are turned off in their key details.
keys_contact_keys_partial_title.description: Tooltip on a contact card's key-count badge when some keys are turned off. $active$ and $total$ are numbers.

keys_contact_keys_all_title.message: Messages are encrypted to all of this contact's keys; any one of them can decrypt.
keys_contact_keys_all_title.description: Tooltip on a contact card's key-count badge when every key is in use.

keys_contact_keys_partial.description: Contact card badge when some of the contact's keys are turned off. $active$ and $total$ are numbers; $total$ is at least 2. Very short.

keys_contact_keys_count_one.description: Contact card badge: how many separate keys this contact holds. Very short.

keys_contact_keys_count_other.description: Contact card badge: how many separate keys this contact holds. Very short.

keys_source_github.description: Contact card provenance line for a key fetched from GitHub. $user$ is the GitHub username; keep 'github.com/'.

keys_source_keyserver.description: Contact card provenance line for a key fetched from keys.openpgp.org. $user$ is the email address looked up; keep 'keys.openpgp.org'.

keys_contact_expired_title.message: This key expired on $date$ and can no longer be encrypted to. Ask the owner for their current key.
keys_contact_expired_title.description: Tooltip on the Expired pill of a contact card. $date$ is a localised long date.

keys_contact_expired.description: Red pill on a contact card. $date$ is a localised short date. Short.

keys_contact_expires.description: Contact card line. $date$ is a localised long date.

keys_contact_options_aria.description: Accessible label of the three-dot menu button on a contact card.

keys_selection_actions_aria.description: Accessible label of the floating toolbar shown while bulk-selecting.

keys_cancel_selection_aria.description: Accessible label of the X button that leaves bulk selection mode.

keys_selected_count_one.description: Selection toolbar: how many cards are selected. $count$ is a number.

keys_selected_count_other.description: Selection toolbar: how many cards are selected. $count$ is a number.

keys_select_all.description: Selection toolbar: label / tooltip of the select-all button.

keys_deselect_all.description: Selection toolbar: label / tooltip of the select-all button when everything is already selected.

keys_export.description: Selection toolbar button: export the selected keys and contacts. Short.

keys_size_bytes.description: File size in bytes, e.g. '512 B'. $size$ is a whole number.

keys_size_kb.description: File size in kilobytes, e.g. '1.2 KB'. $size$ is a number with one decimal.

keys_size_mb.description: File size in megabytes, e.g. '3.4 MB'. $size$ is a number with one decimal.
